Title: Retirement of Computer Vision API v3.2 previews

Body.Content: On 30 January 2023, the Computer Vision API v3.2-preview will be retired. Before that date, you’ll need to migrate your workloads to Computer Vision API v3.2 GA which provides all the preview features plus an improved image captioning model and more languages supported by OCR. After 30 January 2023, you won’t be able to make any calls made to Computer Vision v3.2-preview. To avoid service disruptions, migrate your workloads to Computer Vision API v3.2 GA by 30 January 2023. Please refer to our documentation for guidance on how to migrate your workloads. If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
